I was invited to the Antimonopoly Cases and Decisions Study Group and presented on a case holding that restrictions by fishery cooperatives and their federation on shipments outside the cooperative system constituted an unfair trade practice.

The case note based on this presentation [appeared in *NBL* no. 1284](/en/blog/posts/2025-02-15-56396703/).
